title: Enforce dependencyConvergence in quarkus-bootstrap-core
body:
The dependency tree of `quarkus-bootstrap-core` contains several versions of `wagon-provider-api` which pops us in Camel Quarkus because we enforce dependencyConvergence:

```
[INFO] --- maven-enforcer-plugin:1.4.1:enforce (camel-quarkus-enforcer-rules) @ camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment ---
[WARNING] 
Dependency convergence error for org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.0.0 paths to dependency are:
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.resolver:maven-resolver-transport-wagon:1.4.1
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.0.0
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http-shared:3.3.4
          +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-file:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4

[WARNING] Rule 0: org.apache.maven.plugins.enforcer.DependencyConvergence failed with message:
Failed while enforcing releasability the error(s) are [
Dependency convergence error for org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.0.0 paths to dependency are:
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.resolver:maven-resolver-transport-wagon:1.4.1
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.0.0
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http-shared:3.3.4
          +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-http:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4
and
+-org.apache.camel.quarkus:camel-quarkus-support-common-deployment:1.1.0-SNAPSHOT
  +-io.quarkus:quarkus-core-deployment:999-SNAPSHOT
    +-io.quarkus:quarkus-bootstrap-core:999-SNAPSHOT
      +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-file:3.3.4
        +-org.apache.maven.wagon:wagon-provider-api:3.3.4
]
```

The simplest fix that solves our problem is to replace

```
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.resolver</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-resolver-transport-wagon</artifactId>
        </dependency>
```

with

```
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.resolver</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-resolver-transport-wagon</artifactId>
            <exclusions>
                <exclusion><!-- let's prefer the wagon-provider-api pulled by wagon-http and wagon-file -->
                    <groupId>org.apache.maven.wagon</groupId>
                    <artifactId>wagon-provider-api</artifactId>
                </exclusion>
            </exclusions>
        </dependency>
```

in `independent-projects/bootstrap/core/pom.xml` see https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/7506 .

Should we not introduce `dependencyConvergence` enforcement in `quarkus-bootstrap` so that similar issues do not occur again? WDYT @aloubyansky ?
